name: Exera Ltd
description: Discovery card for Exera Ltd (exera.mu), a Mauritian software company offering tailor-made software and the EXRP cloud ERP. In-browser WebMCP tools (contact_exera, get_exera_info) are registered on the homepage via navigator.modelContext. A hosted remote MCP endpoint is advertised below.

tools.name: contact_exera
tools.description: Send Exera Ltd a project or demo enquiry. Collects name, business, need and message and opens a pre-filled WhatsApp conversation with the team.

tools.name: get_exera_info
tools.description: Return key facts about Exera Ltd: services, the EXRP cloud ERP, Made in Moris certification, green hosting, countries served and contact details.
